source: Franklin International, Titebond Wood Glues FAQ, clamping and drying time
tolerance: Exact at the engine's whole-minute precision; the value is the lower bound of the source's 30-60 minute recommendation.
scope: Checks only that the generic PVA timing recommendation matches the lower bound of Titebond's guidance for unstressed wood-glue joints. It does not verify generic PVA spread rate, open time, full cure time, other glue categories, or stressed joints.
